week_thesis: AI semiconductor sector is under near-term profit-taking pressure from SK Hynix ADR post-IPO pullback (-10% on Nasdaq after record $26.5B debut Friday July 10), Samsung Q2 sell-the-news dynamics, and Middle East tensions. Fundamental AI demand is NOT deteriorating — TSMC guided $39-40B Q2 revenue (+10% sequential), projects >30% FY2026 USD growth, and describes AI/HPC demand as 'extremely robust'; HPC is 61% of TSMC revenue. The current chip selloff is technical/sentiment-driven, NOT fundamental. Portfolio consolidates to 3 high-conviction positions: AMAT (AI equipment supercycle anchor, +46% gain, TSMC Q2 Thursday July 16 is a direct equipment-order catalyst), LLY (defensive GLP-1 healthcare winner, immune to chip volatility, +20% gain), and AMD (Zen 6 Venice launch July 22 + Advancing AI 2026 conference July 22-23 + Q2 earnings Aug 4; Goldman $640 / Stifel $635 targets). Actions: close MU (stop $951.93 at risk with chips -5-10% pre-market) and FLEX (marginal gain, low conviction). Key macro events: CPI June 2026 Tuesday July 14 8:30 AM (May was 4.2% YoY — hot print = tech headwind); bank earnings Tue-Wed (JPM, GS, BAC, WFC, C, MS); TSMC Q2 earnings Thursday July 16 (definitive AI demand barometer, expected beat). LRCX blackout maintained (earnings July 29).

buys.reasoning: AMD fell 8% to ~$516 on July 7 (Samsung Q2 sell-the-news selloff) and recovered +7.75% on July 9, proving buyers step in at this level. Today's pre-market weakness from SK Hynix ADR post-IPO profit-taking (-10%) is not AMD-specific but creates a dip entry. Three hard catalysts in the next 22 days: (1) Zen 6 Venice 2nm server CPU launch July 22 — first TSMC N2-node volume product, expected to take hyperscaler data center share from Intel; (2) Advancing AI 2026 conference July 22-23 — AMD Helios rack-scale AI platform showcase with OpenAI and Meta 6GW GPU roadmap updates; (3) Q2 2026 earnings August 4 — Data Center segment $5.8B +57% YoY in Q1, consensus Q2 ~$11.2B total with DC likely $6.5B+. Goldman Sachs target $640 (+24% upside), Stifel target $635, both citing agentic AI CPU demand inflection. TSMC Q2 earnings Thursday July 16 expected to confirm 'extremely robust' AI chip demand and could trigger broad semiconductor recovery that lifts AMD. Earnings safely August 4 — well within swing hold window. Stop at -5% (~$490). Score +0.234 (universe #1), RS60=+66% vs SPY.
